verdict.rationale: ADK explicitly documents a Tool Confirmation flow described as HITL that can 'guard tool execution with explicit confirmation and custom input,' plus a Workflow Runtime and Task API both explicitly listing human-in-the-loop support with state management for pausing and resuming execution. This directly matches pausing mid-run for human approval and resuming with the decision, though missing for 10: a concrete end-to-end code example showing pause/resume state persistence and independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor GitHub README claims.
